item.text: {"decisions":[{"candidate_id":"N1697","proposed_relation":"distinct_from","model_reason":"左侧“wear resistance”指热电织物抵抗磨损的性能功能，角色为 performance_function；右侧“resistance”在湿度影响语境中指 PEDOT:PSS 薄膜的电子和离子电阻这一物理量，角色为 quantity。两者分别是耐磨性能与电阻量，并非同一概念或分类学上下位。","left_evidence":{"mention_id":"iTE:P1454:n3","quote_span":"thermoelectric performance and wear resistance of TE textiles"},"right_evidence":{"mention_id":"iTE:P0825:n3","quote_span":"the electronic and ionic resistance properties of thin post-treated poly(3,4-ethylene dioxythiophene):poly(styrenesulfonate) (PEDOT:PSS) films"}}]}
